title: Thank you NY Shopper for your review.
text: Thank you NY Shopper for your review.. Based on the review of NY Shopper on September 11, 2013 I have decided not to purchase any of the 5 frames that I need from Art to Frames.  Any company that treats is customers so blatantly disrespectful does not deserve my business.  They told him writing a bad review wouldn't hurt their business... Well let's show them how much it really can hurt.  I'll be purchasing my frames elsewhere even if it costs more money.

product_metadata.title: ArtToFrames 14x18 inch Black Picture Frame, WOMFRBW72079-14x18
features: Comes with Regular Glass and a sawtooth hanger for wall mounting!
Made of MDF - this one of a kind custom picture frame will enhance any piece of art you put in it!
For other colors and non-standard sizes in this frame style search '2WOMFRBW72079-4x4' on amazon.com
Fits 14x18 inch Photos! Actual Frame size (finished size) is 16x20 inches and the frame is 1.25 inches wide.

When you need a classic mid-width black frame look no further! This smooth flat frame is great for showcasing your black and white photos anywhere in your home. Bold prints pop in this frame and diplomas look professional in this this versatile frame.
